language.section.title: Language
language.display.label: Display language
language.display.hint: Changes the interface language on every device signed in to this account. Default follows your system language.
language.prompt.label: Assistant response language
language.prompt.hint: Changes only the language the assistant writes in. Stored evidence, source excerpts, and quoted conversations stay in their original language.
